newsitem.title: USA: Reuters 30-day muni supply rises to $5.990 bln.
newsitem.headline: Reuters 30-day muni supply rises to $5.990 bln.

text.p: Reuters said Monday it calculated its 30-day visible supply of upcoming municipal bond sales at $5.990 billion, up $239 million from Thursday.
Negotiated sales total $4.219 billion in 66 issues and competitive bond sales total $1.771 billion in 141 issues.
Reuters visible supply counts all deals underwriters have either scheduled for sale in the next 30 business days, or have said they tentatively plan to price during the period.

The supply figure is based on sales data compiled by Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group and uses municipal securities with maturities 13 months or longer. All bond deals $1 million or larger are included.
